items.title: Catch the Rain: A Renewed National Call for Water Conservation
items.snippet: Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau PIB Backgrounder Catch the Rain: A Renewed National Call for Water Conservation Posted On: 19 JUL 2026 8:55AM by PIB Delhi In the 135th episode of Mann Ki Baat on 28 June 2026, the Hon’ble Prime Minister called upon citizens to save every drop of rain and ensure that the momentum of water conservation continues across the country.
